text:
Type: grey velvet cushion
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: contemporary, glam, classic
Materials: soft velvet with a subtle sheen, piped edge in matching fabric
Colors: medium cool grey
Shape: square plump cushion with a smooth plush surface, narrow self-piping all around the edge, clean outline, medium size and soft visual weight
Feel: soft, cozy, refined
Goes with: grey, white or charcoal sofas, brass accents, dark wood, mustard or blush touches; contemporary or glam living rooms
